articles.title: Libya Plans New Oil Bidding Rounds Despite Mounting Security Risks
articles.description: Libya has scheduled a bidding round for discovered but undeveloped oil fields in 2027, and another one in 2028 focused on exploration, as it seeks to ramp up oil production despite the unstable security situation. The National Oil Corporation last held a tender for undeveloped oil fields in 2025, the first in 18 years, and last year it awarded five of a total of 22 blocks on offer to companies including Chevron, Eni, Repsol, and QatarEnergy. articles.title: Katni Administration Probes Viral Video Alleging Illegal Sand Mining
articles.description: Katni district administration is investigating a viral video of alleged illegal sand mining. Collector Ashish Tiwari stated the site is likely in neighbouring Umaria district, which has legally approved mines, as Katni tenders are pending.

articles.title: FPJ Exclusive: How Indian AI Startup Zelmier Is Cutting Government Tender Preparation Time From Hours To Under 10 Minutes
articles.description: In an exclusive interview with FPJ Tech Editor Tasneem Kanchwala, Zelmier founder Pranjal Srivastava reveals how his AI startup is reducing government tender discovery and bid preparation time to eight to nine minutes. The bootstrapped startup tracks 82 government platforms and serves 144 businesses.
